# money
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package money keeps amounts of euros as whole cents, so adding prices never rounds, and reads and writes them the Spanish way ("1.234,50 €").

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `func Format(amount Money) string` | Format writes the amount with its currency, the Spanish way: "1.234,50 €"; whole amounts drop the decimals ("12 €"). |
| `func FormatForInput(amount Money) string` | FormatForInput writes the amount without currency ("9,90"), to fill a field that edits it. |
| `type Margin struct{ ... }` | Margin is what the artist earns per unit: price minus cost, and that profit as a share of the price. |
| `func MarginOf(price, cost Money) Margin` | MarginOf is the margin of selling at price what cost cost. |
| `type Money int64` | Money is an amount of euros in whole cents: Money(1250) is 12,50 €. |
| `func Parse(text string) (amount Money, found bool)` | Parse reads what the artist types in a price field ("12", "12,5", "12.50 €"); found is false for empty text, letters, negative amounts and more than two decimals. |
| `func Sum[Item any](items []Item, amountOf func(Item) Money) Money` | Sum adds up the amount each item gives; an empty list adds up to zero. |
